meta_title: AJ Garden Services | Professional Gardener Sheffield
meta_description: AJ Garden Services Sheffield offers expert garden maintenance, landscaping, and design. Local family business serving South Yorkshire. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transformation, we handle it all — and your garden will look brilliant.
services_subhead: Whether you need weekly maintenance, a complete redesign, or specialist tree work, we've got your garden covered.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly upkeep including lawn mowing, hedge trimming, and border care. Keeps your garden looking sharp year-round without the effort.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space and budget. We handle hard landscaping, planting schemes, and patios that transform your outdoor area.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Pruning
services.desc: Professional tree care, felling, stump removal, and large-scale pruning. Safe, certified work that protects your property and improves your garden's structure.

services.title: Turfing & Seeding
services.desc: New lawn installation or overseeding tired grass areas. We prepare the ground properly so your new turf or seed thrives and looks lush within weeks.

services.title: Clearance & Tidying
services.desc: Get control of overgrown gardens, fallen leaves, and debris. We clear the lot, haul it away, and leave your space ready for fresh planting or paving.

services.title: Fencing & Garden Structures
services.desc: New fence installation, repairs, and garden buildings. Durable materials and expert fitting mean your garden boundary lasts and looks the part.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I love seeing gardens come to life.
about_para_1: AJ Garden Services was founded in 2008 with one aim: to give Sheffield homeowners gardens they genuinely enjoy. Over 18 years, we've grown from a one-man operation to a trusted local team, completing over 2,000 garden projects across South Yorkshire. Our reputation is built on reliability, attention to detail, and treating every garden as if it were our own.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest — but we're fair, and you get consistency. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals, which tells you everything. From small front gardens to comprehensive landscaping, we listen to what you want, give you a straight quote, and deliver on time. That's why Sheffield families trust us.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our garden was completely overgrown when we moved in. AJ came round, showed us what was possible, and got stuck in. Three weeks later it's transformed. The team were friendly, tidy, and didn't overcharge. Brilliant work.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using AJ for fortnightly maintenance for two years now. He's reliable, does a proper job, and honestly tells you when something needs attention. My garden looks better than it ever has. Wouldn't use anyone else.
reviews.author: Linda C.

reviews.text: Called AJ to remove a dead oak and tidy up the whole backyard. His team arrived on time, worked safely, cleared everything, and left the space spotless. Fair price and really professional. Can't ask for more.
reviews.author: David W.
